description: Get a workflow with its steps, the edges connecting them, the order a run would reach them, and recent runs. Read this before editing steps: `execution_order` is what actually runs, and any id in `unreachable_step_ids` is a step no run will ever reach.

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: get_workflow

edges.description: The connections a run follows from step to step.

branch.description: 'true' or 'false' for a condition's handles, otherwise null.

source_step_id.description: The step the edge leaves; null is the trigger (workflow entry).

execution_order.description: Step ids in the order a run from the start step reaches them.

recent_runs.description: Up to 10 most recent runs, newest first.

id.description: Run UUID, the run_id get_workflow_run takes.

status.description: pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

trigger_type.description: What started the run, e.g. manual or schedule.

triggered_by.description: User UUID that started it, or null if automatic.

steps.description: Every step row, sorted by sort_order.

config.description: The step config; its keys depend on step_type.

id.description: Step UUID, the step_id the step tools take.

sort_order.description: Position in the editor list. The run order comes from the edges, not this.

step_type.description: One of: run_checklist, condition, notification, delay, github_comment, actor_pr_review, crawl_topology.

trigger_config.description: The first trigger's settings, secret removed; see triggers.

trigger_type.description: The first trigger's type; see triggers.

triggers.description: Everything that starts a run, in order. Each starts at its entry_step_id, or at the start step when that is null.

entry_step_id.description: The step this trigger starts a run at; null is the start step.

trigger_config.description: Trigger settings, e.g. { cron, timezone } for a schedule. A webhook's signing secret is never returned: the webhook URL and secret are in the workflow's settings in the Stunt Double dashboard.

unreachable_step_ids.description: Steps no run will reach; connect or remove them.

title: Get workflow
